projects.title: Smart Pills Box
projects.summary: ESP32-C3 medication manager with custom PCB, 10 schedulable slots, RTC timing and multi-modal alerts.
projects.description:
An embedded IoT medication management device developed on **ESP32-C3**. I designed the custom PCB and the 3D mechanical enclosure using KiCad, Proteus and SolidWorks.

The device schedules up to 10 medication slots with configurable alert windows and keeps real-time tracking with a DS3231 RTC. Reminders are delivered through simultaneous visual (WS2812 LEDs via FastLED) and audio (DFPlayer Mini) alerts, with user feedback through a button and an SH1106 OLED display.

A captive web portal (Access Point) allows wireless configuration of medicine names, times and alert durations; all settings persist via the Preferences library.
features: Up to 10 medication slots with configurable alert windows
WS2812 LED + DFPlayer Mini audio alerts
Battery voltage monitoring with charge detection, adaptive calibration and low-pass filtering
SH1106 OLED UI with push-button feedback

projects.title: DDDAS — Deaf & Dumb Driving Assistant System
projects.summary: Intelligent autonomous-driving assistant enabling deaf and mute individuals to drive, with on-board AI models and a dedicated GUI.
projects.description:
Graduation project (Grade: **Excellent**), showcased at the Thebes Academy Projects Exhibition.

DDDAS is an intelligent driving system that enables deaf and mute individuals to experience fully autonomous driving and integrate seamlessly into society. It features multiple custom AI models for real-time driver–passenger chat, road sign recognition, and auditory environment simulation to interpret surrounding sounds.

A dedicated graphical user interface was designed for the system, which also supports satellite-based autonomous driving.

projects.title: Voltage Guard Pro
projects.summary: Low-cost ATtiny85 mains protector that disconnects appliances outside the 190–250 V window.
projects.description:
A smart, low-cost power protection device designed to safeguard household appliances from dangerous voltage fluctuations.

Built around the **ATtiny85** microcontroller, it continuously monitors the AC mains voltage and instantly disconnects connected devices when the voltage drops below 190 V or exceeds 250 V, protecting sensitive electronics from damage.
features: Instant disconnect below 190 V or above 250 V
